questions.statement: Choose the correct preposition: 'The exam will take place ____ 9 a.m. ____ 11 a.m.'

options.feedback: 'From ... to' is the standard pattern for stating a starting and an ending point.
'In' marks a period or a year, not the limits of an interval.
'For' introduces a duration, and 'till' only gives the end point.
'Since' indicates an origin in time, which is not what the sentence states.

questions.explanation:
Para un intervalo de tiempo se usa 'from' al inicio y 'to' al final; 'till' y 'until' solo indican hasta.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: 'I have lived in Lima ____ 2015.'

options.feedback: 'For' would introduce a duration such as 'for nine years', not a single year as origin.
'Since' marks the origin of a situation that still holds.
'During' marks a period of time when something happens, not an origin that continues.
'Till' gives an endpoint, not a starting point.

questions.explanation:
'Since' introduce el punto de partida de una accion que continua en el presente. Es uno de los puntos mas frecuentes de las pruebas de esta unidad.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence uses 'by' correctly?

options.text: By six o'clock I will have finished the report.
options.feedback: 'By' plus a deadline is the standard future perfect pattern.

options.text: By six o'clock I finish the report.
options.feedback: 'By' requires the future perfect in this structure, not the simple future.

options.text: By of six o'clock I will finish the report.
options.feedback: The preposition 'of' does not belong after 'by' in a time phrase.

options.text: By six o'clock in the report I will finish.
options.feedback: The word order makes the sentence ungrammatical.

questions.explanation:
'By' mas un momento limite indica que la accion estara terminada antes de ese instante.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete the sentence: 'We will wait for you ____ the entrance of the museum.'
questions.context: Preposiciones de lugar y tiempo, Piura.

options.feedback: 'Until' would mark the limit of the waiting, not the place.
'At the entrance' names the specific point where the waiting happens.
'For' introduces a duration and cannot precede a noun phrase of place.
'While' introduces a subordinate clause, not a noun phrase.

questions.explanation:
'At' se usa para un punto de espera concreto; 'until' solo mediria la duracion de la espera.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What is the difference between 'in', 'on' and 'at' with time expressions?

options.text: All three are interchangeable in every context
options.feedback: The choice depends on the length and type of the time expression.

options.text: 'At' with hours, 'on' with days, 'in' with longer periods
options.feedback: That is the standard hierarchy of time prepositions.

options.text: 'In' is only used for the past
options.feedback: 'In' covers months, years and future periods as well.
'On' is also used with days of the week and parts of the day.

questions.explanation:
'At' se usa con horas concretas, 'on' con dias y fechas, e 'in' con meses, anos y periodos largos.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Look at the sentence: 'I arrived ____ Lima ____ March.' Choose the prepositions.
questions.context: Preposiciones de lugar y tiempo, Huaraz.

options.feedback: 'At' is used for specific points, not for cities.
'To' would require a verb of motion, and 'on' does not mark a month.
'At March' is incorrect; months take 'in'.
'In Lima' for a city and 'in March' for a month are both correct.

questions.explanation:
'Arrive' toma 'in' para ciudades y 'in' para meses; no se usa 'at' con ciudades. Conviene practicarlo con otros ejemplos antes del examen.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: 'She has been working here ____ 2019 and still enjoys the job.'

options.feedback: 'For 2019' would need 'for six years'; a bare year takes 'since'.
'From' marks a starting point but does not convey the continuing meaning here.
'During' marks a period of occurrence, not an ongoing situation.
'Since 2019' marks the origin of an ongoing situation.

questions.explanation:
'Since' + ano indica el inicio de una situacion que continua; 'for' + ano exigiria la palabra 'years'.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence uses 'until' correctly?

options.text: The library stays open until nine.
options.feedback: 'Until nine' marks the moment the closing stops.

options.text: The library stays open at nine.
options.feedback: 'At' would name a single instant rather than a limit.

options.text: The library stays open for nine.
options.feedback: 'For' would indicate a duration instead of an endpoint.

options.text: The library stays open since nine.
options.feedback: 'Since' marks an origin, the opposite relation.

questions.explanation:
'Come across' significa encontrar por casualidad o descubrir algo. Este matiz se comprueba comparando con el resto de opciones.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What does 'during' express?

options.text: The action started at that point and continues
options.feedback: That is the function of 'from' or 'since'.

options.text: The action will happen in the future
options.feedback: Future reference requires 'in' plus a future period.

options.text: The action happened inside a defined period
options.feedback: 'During the holiday' locates the event within that period.

options.text: The action lasted a fixed duration
options.feedback: Duration is expressed with 'for'.

questions.explanation:
'During' situa una accion dentro de un periodo de tiempo delimitado. Es uno de los puntos mas frecuentes de las pruebas de esta unidad.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct sentence.

options.text: The class starts in Monday at eight in the morning.
options.feedback: Days of the week take 'on', not 'in'.

options.text: The class starts on Monday in eight on the morning.
options.feedback: 'In' cannot be used with a clock time or with 'the morning'.

options.text: The class starts on Monday at eight in the morning.
options.feedback: Each element takes the preposition its own type requires.

options.text: The class starts for Monday at eight on the morning.
options.feedback: 'For' introduces a duration and cannot precede a day as a time marker.

questions.explanation:
Cada preposicion temporal cumple una funcion: 'on' con el dia, 'at' con la hora, 'in' con el mes.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Look at the sentence: 'I have been waiting since two hours.' What is the error?

options.text: Nothing is wrong with the sentence
options.feedback: 'Since' plus a duration is a standard error.
'Have been waiting' is the correct progressive perfect form.
'Two hours' is correct for a plural duration.

options.text: 'Since' must be 'for' when followed by a duration
options.feedback: 'For two hours' expresses the waiting period correctly.

questions.explanation:
'Since' no puede accompany a una duracion; para eso se usa 'for'. Conviene practicarlo con otros ejemplos antes del examen.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read the text: 'The festival starts on 28 June and lasts for three days.' When does it end?

options.feedback: That is the starting date, not the ending one.
That would require four days to reach the end of June.
Counting three days from 28 June gives the end on 30 June.
The month stated in the text is June, not July.

questions.explanation:
Si comienza el 28 de junio y dura tres dias, termina el 30 de junio. Este matiz se comprueba comparando con el resto de opciones.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence uses the preposition of time before a day correctly?

options.feedback: Days of the week take 'on', not 'in'.
'At' is used for clock times and specific points.
'To' would require a verb of motion or a range.
Days of the week take the preposition 'on'.

questions.explanation:
Los dias de la semana y las fechas llevan siempre la preposicion 'on'. Es uno de los puntos mas frecuentes de las pruebas de esta unidad.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: 'The shop opens ____ nine ____ half past nine.'

options.feedback: 'In' does not link two clock times as limits.
'For' introduces a duration rather than the opening and closing limits.
'From ... till' is the natural pattern for a narrow time interval.
'At' marks single instants, not an interval between two times.

questions.explanation:
Un intervalo corto de horas se expresa con 'from' y 'to' (o 'till') entre las dos horas.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What does 'o'clock' express?

options.text: It marks a duration of one hour
options.feedback: 'O'clock' marks a clock reading, not a length of time.

options.text: It marks the exact hour, with no minutes
options.feedback: 'O'clock' is used only when the minutes are zero.

options.text: It indicates a period in the morning
options.feedback: 'In the morning' marks that period, not 'o'clock'.
'O'clock' indicates an exact time, not an approximation.

questions.explanation:
'O'clock' se usa para indicar la hora exacta, normalmente en punto, y no admite minutos.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence is grammatically and logically correct?

options.text: Since the museum opened, it has attracted many visitors.
options.feedback: 'Since' plus the present perfect links a past opening to a present result.

options.text: Since the museum opens, it attracted many visitors.
options.feedback: The simple past does not fit the present result implied by 'since'.

options.text: Since the museum opened, it attracts many visitors.
options.feedback: The simple present would fit 'since' only with a permanent state, which is unusual here.

options.text: For the museum opened, it has attracted many visitors.
options.feedback: 'For' introduces a duration and cannot precede the opening event.

questions.explanation:
La oracion correcta emplea 'since' para el origen en el pasado y el presente perfecto para la consecuencia vigente.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which question about time is correctly formed?

options.text: How long you have been studying here?
options.feedback: The auxiliary is in the wrong position in this question.

options.text: How long did you study here?
options.feedback: That asks about a completed past period.

options.text: How long are you studying here?
options.feedback: The present continuous does not carry the duration reading.

options.text: How long have you been studying here?
options.feedback: 'How long' plus 'have you been' asks about a period continuing to the present.

questions.explanation:
La pregunta sobre un periodo de tiempo presente usa 'How long' mas el auxiliar correspondiente.

questions.statement: Read: 'The film will be released during the winter holidays.' When will the film appear?

options.feedback: Nothing in the sentence indicates an earlier date.
The sentence does not place the event after the holidays.
'During' places the event inside the stated period.
'Until' would mark an endpoint rather than a period of occurrence.

questions.explanation:
La expresion 'during the winter holidays' situa el lanzo dentro de ese periodo. Conviene practicarlo con otros ejemplos antes del examen.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which option completes the sentence correctly? 'The deadline is ____ Friday at noon.'

options.feedback: 'On Friday at noon' names the exact deadline.
'In Friday' is not a valid combination in standard English.
'During Friday' would suggest an event happening through the whole day, not a deadline.
'While' introduces a clause and cannot precede a noun phrase.

questions.explanation:
Un plazo tiene un punto final concreto: el dia con 'on' y la hora exacta con 'at'. Este matiz se comprueba comparando con el resto de opciones.

questions.statement: Complete the sentence: 'They have lived there ____ 1998, and they still live there.'

options.feedback: 'For 1998' would need 'for twenty-six years'; a bare year requires 'since'.
'Since 1998' marks the origin of a situation that still continues.
'From' marks a starting point but loses the ongoing sense.
'During' marks a period when something occurs, not an ongoing situation.

questions.explanation:
Un ano puntual como origen se expresa con 'since', no con 'for' a secas. Es uno de los puntos mas frecuentes de las pruebas de esta unidad.
